heads.la: Ex Breviario Eborensis Ecclesiae in Lusitania typis impresso anno 1548, pag. 837.IN FESTO SANCTI DAMASI PAPAE ET CONFESSORIS.
heads.en: From the Breviary of the Church of Évora in Lusitania, printed in type in the year 1548, p. 837.ON THE FEAST OF SAINT DAMASUS, POPE AND CONFESSOR.

heads.la: In fine hujus Breviarii haec leguntur: AD LAUDEM OMNIPOTENTIS DEI ET ILLIBATAE SEMPER VIRGINIS MARIAE, EXPLICIT
heads.en: At the end of this Breviary these words are read: TO THE PRAISE OF ALMIGHTY GOD AND OF THE EVER UNDEFILED VIRGIN MARY, HERE ENDS

heads.la: VARIA DE PATRIA S. DAMASI TESTIMONIA.
heads.en: VARIOUS TESTIMONIES CONCERNING THE NATIVE COUNTRY OF ST. DAMASUS.
AN ANALYSIS OF CERTAIN OPINIONS OF THE ABBOT TERRIBILINI.
